title: Bar and line charts on Canvas for the detail screen
findings_note: MainScreen.kt:395-416 (14 stacked LinearProgressIndicator rows labelled with ISO dates)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the calendar heatmap (S42), zoom or pan, comparing trackers, and any chart library.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- The "Recent trend" card is 14 stacked progress bars labelled `2026-04-21` and takes about a screen.
- MEASURE trackers (weight, sleep) need a line chart to be useful.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
JVM, in `ChartMathTest`:
- `summarize counts met days and averages only non-null values`
- `yRange pads the range when all values are equal`
- `barHeight is clamped to the chart height`
- `summary text for a chart with no data says so`

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Data comes from S16: `detail.trend` is a list of `TrendPoint(date, value: Double?, metTarget)` covering 30 days.
2. `ChartMath.kt` (no Compose or Android imports): `summarize(points, target): ChartSummary(daysMet, daysWithData, average)`, `yRange(values): ClosedFloatingPointRange<Double>` (if min == max, pad by 1; otherwise by 10% of the span), `barHeight(value, maxY, chartHeightPx)` clamped to `0..chartHeightPx`.
3. `BarChart(points, targetValue: Double?, modifier)` for COUNT and YES_NO. Use `Canvas(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(160.dp))`. One bar per day with a 2dp gap. `maxY = max(highest value, target, 1.0)`. A day that meets the target is filled with `colorScheme.primary`. Other days are drawn as an outline (`Stroke`) in `colorScheme.outline`. Days with value 0 draw only a 1dp baseline tick. If there is a target, draw a dashed line (`PathEffect.dashPathEffect(floatArrayOf(8f, 8f))`) in `outline`. Label the first, middle and last dates below the chart, using `rememberTextMeasurer()` and `drawText`, with `DateTimeFormatter.ofLocalizedDate(FormatStyle.SHORT)`.
4. `LineChart(points, unit, modifier)` for MEASURE. Draw a `Path` through consecutive non-null points. Start a new subpath (`moveTo`) after every null so gaps stay gaps. Draw a 3dp dot on each point. Label the min and max values with `NumberRules.formatNumber` and the unit. If there are fewer than two non-null points, draw dots only. If all values are null show "No measurements in the last 30 days."
5. In `TrackerDetailScreen`, replace the "Recent trend" card contents: MEASURE shows `LineChart`, other types show `BarChart`. Give each chart `Modifier.semantics { contentDescription = ... }` from `ChartMath.summarize`, for example "Last 30 days: 22 of 30 days met target, average 6.2 glasses".
6. Use only theme colours (`MaterialTheme.colorScheme`). Use `tertiary` only for streak highlights, not here.
7. Give the detail `LazyColumn` a bottom `contentPadding` of 88dp so the FAB does not cover the last history row.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` passes.
- Manual: a COUNT tracker shows bars and a dashed target line. A MEASURE tracker with missing days shows a line with gaps, not dives to zero. Both charts look right in light and dark mode.
- TalkBack reads the chart summary.
